headline.purpose: The one PageHeading title per workspace; largest text in the system.

title.purpose: In-panel section headers: analysis heading, saved-prompt title.

label.purpose: Functional per-message sender tag (USER/ASSISTANT) — the system's only uppercase small-caps text.

nav-label.purpose: Rail link text, desktop and mobile bottom-bar.

mono.purpose: Code blocks inside streamed assistant markdown.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: The system's only shadow. Lifts the single active workspace panel a fraction off the bright-paper canvas.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition for rail-link color/background, converter-dropzone border/background.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per workspace (Generate, Run comparison, New prompt).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6346db; color: #fff; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 680; text-transform: none; box-shadow: none; transition: background-color 0.16s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4930b5; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b7a7ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Secondary file/attach actions (Browse files, Add source image).
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { background: transparent; color: #171824; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #dfe1ea; border-radius: 10px; font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 680; box-shadow: none; transition: border-color 0.16s ease-out, background-color 0.16s ease-out; } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { border-color: #6346db; background: #faf9ff; } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b7a7ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rail Nav Link
components.description: Persistent rail item; solid violet fill when active.
components.html: Assistant
components.css: .ds-rail-link { min-height: 42px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; color: #c4c5d3; text-decoration: none; font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 620; transition: background-color 0.16s ease-out, color 0.16s ease-out; } .ds-rail-link:hover { color: #fff; background: #2b2d40; } .ds-rail-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b7a7ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rail-link--active { color: #fff; background: #6346db; }

components.name: Workspace Panel
components.description: The one active-tool surface per screen; the system's only shadow lives here.
components.css: .ds-workspace-panel { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #dfe1ea; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(33,35,52,0.06); padding: 18px; }

components.name: Status Chip (success)
components.description: Explicit-state marker: a model provider reporting available.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip--success { background: #16845b; color: #fff; } .ds-chip--outlined { background: transparent; border: 1px solid #dfe1ea; color: #171824; }

components.name: Chat Message (user)
components.description: Signature component: the tail-cornered user bubble, asymmetric 12/12/3/12 radius.
components.css: .ds-chat-bubble-user { margin-left: auto; width: fit-content; max-width: min(780px, 86%); padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 12px 12px 3px 12px; background: #ebe7ff; font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #171824; }

components.name: Converter Dropzone
components.description: Signature component: the only dashed-border element, standing in for a text input where the material is a file.
components.html: <label class="ds-dropzone" tabindex="0">Drop a workbook or click to browse<input type="file" hidden></label>
components.css: .ds-dropzone { min-height: 300px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 30px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; background: #fff; border: 1px dashed #dfe1ea; border-radius: 12px; transition: border-color 0.16s ease-out, background-color 0.16s ease-out; } .ds-dropzone:hover { border-color: #6346db; background: #faf9ff; } .ds-dropzone:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #a897ef; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Prism reads as an instrument, not a dashboard: a dark graphite rail holds the tool selector at rest, and every chosen tool opens onto a bright paper canvas where a single white workspace panel does the work. Spectral violet is the one indicator light in the system — it marks the active tool, the primary action, and the focus ring, and nowhere else. The product carries direct, technical, task-oriented language (per PRODUCT.md's Brand Commitments) and the built surface matches it: no illustration, no gradients beyond the small brand mark, no marketing voice.

The build confirms the OWN-WORLD brief exactly — graphite planes (the rail, #202130), bright paper (the canvas, #f3f4f8), spectral violet (#6346db) as the lone accent, crisp 1px rules instead of shadows for most separation, and compact controls (40px buttons, 42px rail links, 0.72–0.88rem labels). Depth is nearly flat: the workspace panel carries the system's only shadow, a soft ambient lift barely visible against the paper. There are no decorative kickers, no hard-offset shadows, and no glyph iconography beyond functional MUI action icons (send, attach, delete) sized to the compact-control scale.
keyCharacteristics: Two structural planes only: dark graphite rail, bright paper canvas, with pure-white workspace panels floating a fraction above the canvas.
One accent color, reserved for the active/primary state.
Flat-by-default depth; a single soft shadow, no card lift ladder.
Crisp 1px hairline rules do most of the separation work shadows would otherwise do.
A single font family (Aptos/Segoe UI Variable) carries every role from page title to body to labels.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Spectral Violet appears only on the active/selected/primary-action state — never as a decorative background wash. Its own tinted family (violet-wash, violet-mist, violet-frost, violet-line) exists solely to shade elements already tied to the accent; it never substitutes for Bright Paper as the general canvas color.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: One font stack serves display, body, and label roles across the whole product; hierarchy is carried by weight, size, and letter-spacing, never by introducing a second face.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one shadow value in the system, and it exists to separate the single workspace panel from the canvas beneath it — not to create an elevation ladder. No other element carries a shadow.

dos: Do keep Spectral Violet to a single role per screen: the active nav item, the one primary action, and focus rings.
Do use 1px hairline rules (Rule Gray on paper, Graphite Line on graphite) as the default way to separate regions.
Do give every focusable control the shared 3px Violet Focus outline — it is the accessibility contract, not a decorative flourish.
Do let a control's enabled/disabled or color state be the explicit-state signal the STORY calls for, instead of adding separate status text.
Do hold buttons, chips, and result tiles flat; reserve the one ambient shadow for the workspace panel only.
donts: Don't add a second shadow value or stack shadows on top of borders; the system has exactly one shadow and it belongs to the workspace panel.

Don't introduce uppercase kicker/eyebrow labels above page or section titles — the only uppercase small-caps text in the product is the functional per-message sender label inside chat, and it does not generalize to other headings.
Don't use hard-offset (non-blurred) shadows or thick neobrutalist borders; Prism's world is soft-shadow-and-hairline, not that one.
Don't introduce a second typeface for emphasis or display text; hierarchy comes from weight/size/letter-spacing within the single Aptos/Segoe UI Variable stack.
Don't reuse the brand mark's rotated color bars as a general decorative motif; it is confined to the one brand lockup instance.
